newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps lowers American Investors Life.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps lowers American Investors Life.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it lowered the claims paying ability rating of American Investors Life Insurance Co to Single A from Single A Plus.

The rating reflects a decline in financial flexibility with the recent issue of debt by American Investors Life's parent, AmVestors Financial Corp and below-average statutory profitability due to high surrender levels and strain from premium growth.
American Investors Life also bears business concentration risk as a specialty provider of single premium deferred annuities.
